Name: (AT)ribbon cottage
Author: UsagiQwQ
Description:
这是一个以蝴蝶结和可爱风为主题的小屋外观美化模组，专为 Alternative Textures（AT）设计。安装后，你可以通过 AT 工具将农舍换成梦幻柔和的浅色系样式，屋顶、墙面和细节中融入了丝带、装饰等精致元素。目前版本只包含农夫小屋，默认提供一个主色调，后续会更新更多结局，并补充所有农场建筑的替换版本，让你的农场在每个季节都可爱又温馨。
目前版本只包含农夫小屋，默认提供一种主色调，今后会陆续更新更多配色，并补充所有农场建筑的替换版本，让你的农场在每个季节都可爱又温馨。This is a cute, ribbon-themed farmhouse retexture designed for use with Alternative Textures (AT). With this mod, you can use the AT Paint Bucket to transform your farmhouse into a dreamy, soft-colored version with light tones, ribbon details, and charming decorations.
Currently, only the farmhouse is available with one default color, but more color options and matching buildings for the entire farm will be added in future updates to complete the sweet and cozy aesthetic.
